cuts.item: Pavement management line cut to balance the town side budget
A teacher at the high school in every discipline, and a teacher at each younger grade level (some brought back)

statements.statement: A citizens' petition for an override was submitted and signatures verified by the clerk.
Reduction in debt service this year of over three hundred thousand, which the manager wants to keep out of the operating budget.
Second debt figure stated alongside the reduction; meaning garbled.
Town budget is very much in flux; most department requests supported, payment management program is the biggest open item.
School committee voted the town manager's number for the school budget the night before and says allocation decisions are final.
Net school choice tuition deficit per last DLS assessment was stated; another figure near seven hundred thousand for FY25.
Free cash transfers are very much up in the air after the select board meeting.

warnings.prediction: Without more state action, the town's budget cannot meet needs; a resident said cuts could mean layoffs of employees.

warnings.about: school choice capacity and class sizes
warnings.prediction: Won't fill school choice seats and class sizes may reach 30 in younger grades given teacher cuts.
Maybe the town should have no capital plan this year given budget problems.
